ActorTalk: With classes suspended, the students are falling behind on too much.
Aren't you the one who always says real combat is the best teacher?
Hmph. Sure, that sounds nice, but you can't improvise in the field without the basics to back you up. Once a student falls behind there, it's almost impossible to catch up later.

Every top graduate we've had built their skills from solid fundamentals. Take [PlayerName] from a few years back. That student's tactical decisions in live exercises even beat the system's projections.
I remember that student well. [PlayerName] stood out in my general studies class too.

And then there was that kid from the Langston family. A pity, really. I respected how hard he pushed himself in the connection test. But damaging his consciousness permanently just to get ahead? That was not worth it.
He goes by Chrome now. He's done well for himself in Strike Hawk and earned quite a few commendations already.
